orientation: north at row 0; west at column 0; Godot +X east, +Z south
land_source_vertical_datum: PL-KRON86-NH as declared by GUGiK WCS coverage
bathymetry_method: EMODnet signed elevation used to shape sea depth then clamped 2–15m; inland depth designed from distance to bank; no absolute vertical-datum equivalence claimed
river_bank_blending: 2-pixel normalized Gaussian bed smoothing; first wet samples at depth 2m, easing into deeper beds over 70m; first dry samples at 20.1m, easing into measured land over 80m; outer limit about 94.2m from water samples; far-field unchanged
nodata: GUGiK coverage audited tile by tile; source zero-only ocean cells excluded by coastline mask; no unknown land gaps silently filled
historical_limitations: Contemporary DTM and OSM waterways, not reconstructed 1960 terrain. Modern embankments and infrastructure may remain.
water_rendering: Use water meshes limited to water_mask footprint at y=20; a map-wide plane would flood real dry polders below sea level.

terrain3d_import.format: 32-bit float RGB; linear metre elevations; no alpha
terrain3d_import.note: 10m spacing is suggested only; no engine scene/import created. Use exact anisotropic sample spacing in GIS; Terrain3D uniform spacing introduces the explicitly recorded tiny scale difference.

sources.name: GUGiK bare-earth NMT
sources.access_constraints: WCS capabilities: none; fees none; retain attribution to GUGiK/PZGIK

sources.name: EMODnet Bathymetry
sources.attribution: EMODnet Bathymetry Consortium (2024). EMODnet Digital Bathymetry (DTM 2024). Created by EMODnet, owned by the European Union.

shoreline_constraint: The 2m minimum depth requires a residual 2.1m step between adjacent wet/dry samples. No unapproved 0–2m-deep shoreline apron added.

existing_imported_scene.note: Existing user import preserved; source EXR values remain unchanged.

selective_height_compression.feature: Wiślinka pile and Sobieszewo dune belt only; southwest hills deferred
selective_height_compression.note: Direct changes to imported Terrain3D region height maps. Do not reimport the original EXR expecting these later terrain edits to be present in it.
